
yudit is a neato-keen [http://www.unicode.org nicode] text-editor for [[jbocre: Unix|Unix]] with its own

built-in support for !TrueType fonts. It is distributed with a number

of modes for entering [http://www.unicode.org nicode] text in a variety of writing systems.

([[jbocre: Esperanto|(Esperanto]], Japanese, Hungarian, Greek, etc)

http://www.yudit.org/
